european towns that

colmar, france

half-timbered houses
over the canals.

hallstatt, austria

a village on the edge
of a mountain lake.

giethoorn, netherlands

no roads, only canals
and little bridges.

bibury, england

stone cottages from
the 17th century.

český krumlov, czechia

red roofs in a bend
of the river.

rothenburg, germany

the medieval town
that time forgot.
